mapper.sql: select a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.category_id, a.status, a.publisher_id, a.publisher_name, a.reviewer_id, a.review_comment, a.publish_time, a.expire_time, a.is_top, a.view_count, a.deleted, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, c.category_name from tb_announcement a left join tb_category c on a.category_id = c.id and c.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into tb_announcement ( title, content, summary, category_id, status, publisher_id, publisher_name, is_top, create_by, remark, create_time ) values ( #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, #{publisherId}, #{publisherName}, #{isTop}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update tb_announcement set deleted = 1, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}

update tb_announcement
status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_comment = #{reviewComment},
publish_time = sysdate(),
update_time = sysdate()
where id = #{id}
update tb_announcement set view_count = view_count + 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from tb_announcement where deleted = 0) as announcementCount, (select count(*) from sys_user where del_flag = '0') as userCount, (select ifnull(sum(view_count), 0) from tb_announcement where deleted = 0) as totalViews, (select count(*) from tb_announcement where deleted = 0 and date(create_time) = curdate()) as todayCount from dual

select c.category_name as name, count(a.id) as value from tb_category c left join tb_announcement a on a.category_id = c.id and a.deleted = 0 and a.status = 2 where c.deleted = 0 group by c.id, c.category_name order by c.sort_order

select date_format(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as count from tb_announcement where deleted = 0 and status = 2 and publish_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date
